descriptor_docs.crack: Attack-to-body contrast in the wire band (~2-8 kHz) — the initial snap.
descriptor_docs.snap: Wire rattle against shell tone over the first ~140 ms. High = wires wide open, low = muted / tuned-down thud.
descriptor_docs.bright: Share of body energy above ~3.5 kHz.
descriptor_docs.decay: Early-to-late energy ratio over ~93-370 ms. Higher = tight, gated crack; lower = ringing, room-heavy snare.
